basis: Uploaded13pagePDF, sections3-4 and current repository protocol/calibration implementation; no model training or controlled-file edits

paper_identity.title: A task-oriented few-shot spectroscopy benchmark: Empirical evaluation of meta-learning approaches

main_judgement: The most useful transfer is task-oriented evaluation under domain shifts, not automatically replacing teacherSVM withMAML. The paper isNIR/MIR continuous-property regression; the plannedTHz growing-origin problem is classification.

paper_evidence.observation: Benchmark tasks are continuous-property regression; tasks distinguish industrial settings/year/region/property. Each task has support and query.
SG first derivative and response standardization;MMD and Pearson-feature-importance cosine similarity quantify heterogeneity.
SharedResNet-based backbone, fine-tuning, episodicMAML, SNAIL, prototype-weighted regression, SimCLR encoder baselines.
Actual extreme settings are5/10/25 support instances per regression task, not per-class1/3-shot classification;5-shot can yield negativeR2.
Synthetic spectral-noise/drift robustness is distinct from a new independentTHz acquisition batch.

recommended_primary_task.name: Known growing-origin classes, previously unseen acquisition/preparation/harvest batches of the same medicinal species
recommended_primary_task.label: categorical verified growing origin
recommended_primary_task.task_unit: an acquisition/preparation/harvest domain containing the same origin vocabulary, with independent physical samples
not_task_definition: Do not call each origin a domain while also holding it out as an unseen class and claim ordinary same-class domain adaptation.
Do not treat5Excel workbooks or405scan columns as independent meta-training tasks.
Do not treat n/alpha/time/frequency sheets as4new sample cohorts.

metadata_gate.current_known: User confirms filename places mean growing origins; several exact file/column-to-origin mappings and physical sample/batch relationships remain unresolved.
metadata_gate.group_rule: All repeat scans and pellets from the same original powder/physical sample stay together; group at the highest shared preparation/material unit that would otherwise leak.
metadata_gate.confounding_rule: Each origin should be represented across independent batches; one batch per origin cannot distinguish origin from batch.

phased_plan.work: Read/align frequency units and effective band; complete metadata; prepare a domain-aware partition manifest. Run no origin model with invented labels.
phased_plan.reason: Available405scans and42ginseng pellets do not establish independent domains.

phased_plan.work: Once groups exist, train source-onlySVM/PLS-DA and a modest shared1Dencoder if sample size justifies it; compare target-only, fullsource+support refit, frozen-source head refit and source-anchored score correction.
phased_plan.reason: Meta-training may not be supportable with few independent acquisition tasks; strong classical/fine-tuning baselines are required.

phased_plan.work: Compare source-only prototypes, support-only prototypes on a frozen source embedding, and a source-anchored prototype blend; call this prototype adaptation unless the encoder is actually episodically meta-trained.
phased_plan.reason: A simple testable mechanism fits same-class target-batch calibration better than assuming largeMAML benefits.

phased_plan.work: Only after enough independent source tasks and held-out validation tasks are available, compare episodically trained categoricalProtoNet andMAML with cross-entropy, same encoder and matched tuning budgets.
phased_plan.reason: The paper regression-weighted targets/head/loss cannot be copied directly into origin classification.

phased_plan.work: Freeze preprocessing, candidatebands/DFTpriors, adaptationstrength and source model; test on newly acquired independent target batches.
phased_plan.reason: Existing external benchmark tests have already informed research direction and are exploratory.

candidate_prototype_baseline.status: proposal only; existing idea, not implemented or novel here
candidate_prototype_baseline.embedding: z=f_source(x), trained only on source data; may use fixedPCA/sourceencoder and physical n/alpha features
candidate_prototype_baseline.source_centroid: c_source,k = mean source embedding of classk
candidate_prototype_baseline.target_centroid: c_support,k = mean target-support embedding of classk
candidate_prototype_baseline.prediction: argmin class-distance or temperature-softmax over negative squared distances; posterior calibration not implied
candidate_prototype_baseline.tuning: kappa,temperature,normalization andmetric fixed using source-held-out-domain episodes; no finalquery labels
candidate_prototype_baseline.limit: Known source classcentroid needed; previously unseenorigins need a separate classincremental/open-set protocol.

support_query_protocol.K_note: Proposed classification settings, not settings shown by uploaded paper and not a sample-size guarantee. Kmeans independent physical samples per known class, not repeats.
support_query_protocol.query_rule: Within each held-out targetbatch, preassign a calibrationpool sufficientforlargestK and a disjoint fixedquery; use nested support sizes and identicalquery acrossK/methods. AtK0 calibrationpool remains excluded fromquery.
support_query_protocol.feasibility: Require at leastKmax+q independent physical samples per class in thetargetdomain; if impossible reduceK or declare unavailable. Never duplicate or synthesize support IDs to meetK.
support_query_protocol.repetitions: Repeat support selection in a predeclared design (e.g.20draws); paired same draw across methods. DescriptiveSD reflects support sensitivity, not20independent cohorts.
support_query_protocol.meta_train_query: Querylabels in source/meta-training episodes may drive outer-loop training. This is different from final targetquery, whose labels are for scoring only.
support_query_protocol.validation: Use source-held-out-batch/meta-validationepisodes for hyperparameters, featurecounts, augmentation/noise amplitude, fusion weights and calibrationstrength.1shot/class does not support ordinary classpreserving supportCV.
support_query_protocol.transduction: Do not use finalquery spectraldistribution in an inductive claim; if used for alignment, label it separately as transductive.

what_to_adapt_not_copy.proposal: Compare predetermined raw/SG/SNV representations within training partitions; derivatives not mandatory forTHz and may amplify weak/highfrequency noise. Useactualtime/frequency spacing and exclude coordinate columns.
Do notzscore arbitrary categorical originIDs. Useonehot targets/categorical loss for classification.
Useclass prototypes and categorical distances for origin classification; numeric originIDs have no interpolation meaning.
Optional descriptive source-vs-targetsupport MMD with prespecified features/kernel, classbalance controls, and smallsupport uncertainty; not a guaranteed selector of winningalgorithms.
CannotPearson-correlate spectra with arbitrary originintegercodes. Considerper-classonehot effects/ANOVA/classifierimportance estimated on sourcevalidation folds; reportchoice explicitly.
Useful controlledencoder for FT/metric/MAML comparisons if enough independentsamples; n/alpha can be2alignedchannels or calibrated featureconcat, not4independentmodalcohorts.
Runphysicallyplausible perturbation tests as supplements to realbatch/instrumentholdout, with amplitudes estimated on sourcerepeats and actualunits.
Usebandimportance to motivate chemical/standard/DFT checks; attribution alone is not molecular peakassignment or causality.

metrics.uncertainty: Aggregatebysample/batch, report pairedrepeatdistributions and independentdomain counts; repeatedoverlappingqueryevaluations do not establish independentCI.
metrics.not_applicable: PaperMSE/MAE/R2 cannot be advertised as classificationaccuracy; useRMSEP/MAE/R2only when realchemicalconcentrationlabels exist.
